C0055.title: Little Swan Dongshan Store Hit by 70 Million Yuan Pricing Error Exploit
C0055.summary: In August 2024, a pricing error at Little Swan's Dongshan store caused a high-end washing machine originally priced at 5,000 yuan to be listed for 500 yuan. Exploiters using automated scripts placed massive orders within 30 minutes, resulting in a staggering 70 million yuan in goods being fraudulently obtained, shocking the industry.
